Order 
 1] They are heard.
Perused the case-diary.

2] This is the first application filed by the applicant un the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail as she is apprehending her arrest in connection with Crime No.255/2025 registered at Police Station Pithampur, District Dhar for the offence punishable under Sections 318(4), 316(2) & 3(5) of B.N.S., 2023 (420, 406 and 34 of IPC).
3] The allegation against the applicant is of fraud, as the applicant had sold 3,46,500/- shares of her company Balaji Steroids and Hormones Pvt. Limited for a consideration of Rs.1,50,00,000/-.

sentences.text: However, according to the complainant, he does not wish to continue with the aforesaid shares, and wants to return the same to the applicant, and the applicant is not accepting the same, nor the amount is being given back to the complainant.

NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:25226 2 MCRC-35938-2025 4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant would return the entire amount within six months time,
provided the shares are also returned to the applicant.

Smt. Jaismina vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68558177/
1 5] In view of the same, this Court is inclined to allow to present application with a condition that the complainant shall return the shares to the applicant within the aforesaid period of six months, and after receiving all the shares, the applicant shall return the amount of consideration i.e.
Rs.1,50,00,000/- to the complainant as per the return of the shares.

sentences.text: 6] Accordingly, with the aforesaid condition, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail, upon her executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) and furnishing one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
The applicant shall make herself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
She shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
7] Accordingly, MCRC stands allowed.
